summary: Verified /api/admin/server-ip bug fix + admin regression. 7/7 pytest passed. 10 sequential calls all returned outbound_ip=46.20.101.18, resolution_method=proxy_env, static_proxy_configured=true — no 'unknown' ever seen. UI Admin Settings > Server tab shows 46.20.101.18 immediately, 5 rapid refreshes never flashed 'unknown', and copy toast says 'Copied 46.20.101.18'. Admin regression endpoints (/admin/deposits, /admin/settings, /admin/users) return 200; /settings/public and /referrals/rewards intact.
critical_code_review_comments: Fallback ip-echo path (resolution_method='echo:*') is not covered by an automated test — the review request asked for a monkeypatch pytest that unsets HTTPS_PROXY, but this cannot be done against the remote preview backend without restarting supervisor with a modified env. Recommend a unit-level test that imports the handler directly and patches os.environ inside a process-local FastAPI TestClient if regression coverage of the fallback path is desired.
Endpoint imports `re` twice inside the function body (line ~3178 and ~3215) — trivial cleanup: move to module-level import.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter21 covered only the /admin/server-ip determinism fix + basic admin regression. The multi-service fallback path (no HTTPS_PROXY) is NOT covered by an automated test — preview env has HTTPS_PROXY baked in. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_server_ip.py.
rca of the issue: Original code called ipify.org with a 5s timeout on every request; transient DNS/rate-limit failures returned 'unknown'. Fix parses HTTPS_PROXY hostname; when it's a numeric IPv4 (46.20.101.18) it is returned directly with resolution_method='proxy_env' — no external network call, so no flakiness. Verified deterministic across 10 sequential calls.
